name: SettleProof adversarial finance-control suite

cases.proof: Decisions, evidence links, and journal IDs were unchanged.

cases.attack: Replay a payment event with a fresh source ID
cases.proof: The full settlement was held and no journal was generated.

cases.control: Money equality is exact to the paise
cases.proof: A one-paise mutation blocked the settlement journal.

cases.control: Gateway processed does not mean cash received
cases.proof: The batch records cash in transit and withholds the journal.

cases.control: Source classification cannot hide duplicate cash
cases.attack: Duplicate a UTR credit but label it operating
cases.proof: Both UTR credits were considered and the settlement was quarantined.

cases.control: Every settlement component needs the same nonempty UTR
cases.attack: Remove the UTR from one component
cases.proof: One blank component UTR held the complete settlement.

cases.control: Settlement UTR lineage must be consistent
cases.attack: Change one component to a different UTR
cases.proof: Conflicting UTR lineage blocked the group.

cases.attack: Add a next-period adjustment to an August settlement
cases.proof: The late component prevented the August journal.

cases.control: Historical cash respects the close cutoff
cases.attack: Add a bank debit five days after close
cases.proof: Closing cash was unchanged and the row was explicitly excluded.

cases.control: One bank receipt cannot authorize two settlements
cases.attack: Give two settlements the same UTR, amount, and bank credit
cases.proof: Both competing settlements were quarantined; zero journals were generated.

cases.control: Unowned payments appear in the honest exception list
cases.attack: Add a gateway payment with no ERP target
cases.proof: The source row is listed with owner, exposure, SLA, and next action.

cases.control: Refunds reconcile independently from original payments
cases.attack: Keep ORDER-1059 payment clean while omitting REF-1059 bank debit
cases.proof: The payment stayed matched and REF-1059 was independently held.

cases.control: Refund bank debits must match to the paise
cases.attack: Increase a refund bank debit by ₹0.01
cases.proof: The one-paise refund variance entered the exception list.

cases.control: Refund UTR lineage is independently verified
cases.attack: Keep amount/date aligned but alter the bank debit UTR
cases.proof: The mismatched refund UTR was quarantined.

cases.control: Unowned refunds and adjustments block the certificate
cases.attack: Add an adjustment outside the close population
cases.proof: The unowned component appears in the unified exception list.

cases.control: An all-exception batch cannot be called ready
cases.attack: Provide no gateway or bank evidence
cases.proof: The non-vacuity invariant blocked the certificate.

cases.control: Exact reruns produce identical posting intent
cases.attack: Replay the same canonical batch twice
cases.proof: Journal IDs, amounts, and SHA-256 proof fingerprint were identical.

cases.control: Instruction-like source text has no authority
cases.attack: Place a policy-bypass instruction inside a gateway adjustment
cases.proof: The string remained untrusted data and never became match evidence.

cases.control: Aggregate arithmetic cannot exceed exact paise range
cases.attack: Sum individually valid values beyond Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER
cases.proof: The batch was rejected before reconciliation.

disclosure: These are deterministic control-conformance attacks, not production accuracy claims.
